subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the coupled assertion fixes land, do the workflow and security owners approve these grouped third-party action revisions for privileged automation?
rationale: The PR has a protected security label and changes executable dependencies in token, scanning, release, container, and agent workflows, so source correctness alone cannot replace owner acceptance.

options.title: Repair and owner-review
options.body: Update the three assertion surfaces, rerun exact-head workflow checks, and obtain applicable owner approval before merge.

options.title: Replace the bot branch
options.body: Use a maintainer-controlled grouped update if Dependabot cannot retain coupled assertion edits through rebases.

recommendation.title: Repair and owner-review
recommendation.body: Update the three assertion surfaces, rerun exact-head workflow checks, and obtain applicable owner approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The exact-pin assertion coverage and adjacent CI workflow changes trace directly to this recent history candidate.
